say:1:1735901001:1.text: A mage who can turn into a wolf... Hmph...
say:1:1735901001:1.male: A mage who can turn into a wolf... Hmph...
say:1:1735901001:1.female: A mage who can turn into a wolf... Hmph...

say:2:1735901002:1.text: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...
say:2:1735901002:1.source_cn: 那个金发的人类最害怕的东西……
say:2:1735901002:1.male: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...
say:2:1735901002:1.female: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...

choice_prompt:3:1735901002.text: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...
choice_prompt:3:1735901002.source_cn: 那个金发的人类最害怕的东西……
choice_prompt:3:1735901002.male: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...
choice_prompt:3:1735901002.female: The thing that golden-haired human fears the most...

say:4:1735901003:1.text: He used to be fond of us! He said that seeing us soar brought him joy.
say:4:1735901003:1.source_cn: 他过去很喜欢我们。他说，看见我们展翅翱翔，心中也会升起...
say:4:1735901003:1.male: He used to be fond of us! He said that seeing us soar brought him joy.
say:4:1735901003:1.female: He used to be fond of us! He said that seeing us soar brought him joy.

say:5:1735901004:1.text: But when he grew wings himself... he chose to cut them off.
say:5:1735901004:1.source_cn: 但当他真正长出翅膀后，却选择亲手把它们割了下来……
say:5:1735901004:1.male: But when he grew wings himself... he chose to cut them off.
say:5:1735901004:1.female: But when he grew wings himself... he chose to cut them off.

say:6:1735901005:1.text: After that, he still came here, but he wouldn't look at us. He was disgusted by what once brought him joy.
say:6:1735901005:1.source_cn: 那之后他还是经常来，但不看我们。他对他曾经的喜悦感到恶心。
say:6:1735901005:1.male: After that, he still came here, but he wouldn't look at us. He was disgusted by what once brought him joy.
say:6:1735901005:1.female: After that, he still came here, but he wouldn't look at us. He was disgusted by what once brought him joy.

say:7:1735901006:1.text: He only came to see the falcon-man he kept imprisoned.
say:7:1735901006:1.source_cn: 他来这里……都是见那个被他关着的鹰人。
say:7:1735901006:1.male: He only came to see the falcon-man he kept imprisoned.
say:7:1735901006:1.female: He only came to see the falcon-man he kept imprisoned.

say:8:1735901007:1.text: Both of them... they breathe in pain, as if their throats had been torn out.
say:8:1735901007:1.source_cn: 金发的人、鹰人，他们都经常痛苦地呼吸，像是被咬断了喉咙。
say:8:1735901007:1.male: Both of them... they breathe in pain, as if their throats had been torn out.
say:8:1735901007:1.female: Both of them... they breathe in pain, as if their throats had been torn out.

say:9:1735901008:1.text: That golden-haired man drove himself mad. He was afraid of becoming like us, afraid of the mage who would harm him...
say:9:1735901008:1.source_cn: 金发的人类把自己折磨疯了。他害怕变成鹰，害怕会害了他的...
say:9:1735901008:1.male: That golden-haired man drove himself mad. He was afraid of becoming like us, afraid of the mage who would harm him...
say:9:1735901008:1.female: That golden-haired man drove himself mad. He was afraid of becoming like us, afraid of the mage who would harm him...

say:10:1735901009:1.text: So he chose recklessness. He wanted to leap like a cliff, but refused to spread his wings.
say:10:1735901009:1.source_cn: 于是他放手一搏。不去思考。不想后果。他想从悬崖跳下去，...
say:10:1735901009:1.male: So he chose recklessness. He wanted to leap like a cliff, but refused to spread his wings.
say:10:1735901009:1.female: So he chose recklessness. He wanted to leap like a cliff, but refused to spread his wings.

say:11:1735901010:1.text: Orion's face appears in your mind. Young, but twisted with anxiety and despair. He stands frozen among the Hypofiends, nearly torn apart by his conflicting emotions.
say:11:1735901010:1.source_cn: 你的眼前浮现起了奥利安的脸。年轻的脸庞被焦虑、恐惧、绝...
say:11:1735901010:1.male: Orion's face appears in your mind. Young, but twisted with anxiety and despair. He stands frozen among the Hypofiends, nearly torn apart by his conflicting emotions.
say:11:1735901010:1.female: Orion's face appears in your mind. Young, but twisted with anxiety and despair. He stands frozen among the Hypofiends, nearly torn apart by his conflicting emotions.

say:12:1735901011:1.text: For some reason, your mind drifts to that other person.
say:12:1735901011:1.source_cn: 不知为何，你又想到了那个人。
say:12:1735901011:1.male: For some reason, your mind drifts to that other person.
say:12:1735901011:1.female: For some reason, your mind drifts to that other person.

say:13:1735901012:1.text: An old classmate, a former rival, and now...
say:13:1735901012:1.source_cn: 昔日的同窗，过去的对手，现在的……
say:13:1735901012:1.male: An old classmate, a former rival, and now...
say:13:1735901012:1.female: An old classmate, a former rival, and now...

say:14:1735901013:1.text: Is this how it ends? His face, mad and twisted as the abyss swallowed him... Is this truly the end?
say:14:1735901013:1.source_cn: 一切就这么结束了吗？他被深渊吞噬前，那疯狂而扭曲的神情...
say:14:1735901013:1.male: Is this how it ends? His face, mad and twisted as the abyss swallowed him... Is this truly the end?
say:14:1735901013:1.female: Is this how it ends? His face, mad and twisted as the abyss swallowed him... Is this truly the end?

say:15:1735901014:1.text: Cyran, and all the schemes he set in motion... So many questions remain. What he revealed was only a fragment; greater trials lie ahead.
say:15:1735901014:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷，还有他引发的一系列阴谋……疑点重重。恐怕他揭...
say:15:1735901014:1.male: Cyran, and all the schemes he set in motion... So many questions remain. What he revealed was only a fragment; greater trials lie ahead.
say:15:1735901014:1.female: Cyran, and all the schemes he set in motion... So many questions remain. What he revealed was only a fragment; greater trials lie ahead.

say:16:1735901015:1.text: Go back. There's nothing left here.
say:16:1735901015:1.source_cn: 回去吧，魔法师。这里什么都没剩下了。
say:16:1735901015:1.male: Go back. There's nothing left here.
say:16:1735901015:1.female: Go back. There's nothing left here.
